mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over the prior month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, the 20-day forward returns of SPX are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in new housing starts (HOUST) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal a broad-based economic contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 1.0% and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: When both HOUST and PAYEMS decline by the specified thresholds, the 20-day forward returns of SPX are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235) and tight labor market (UNRATE < 5.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to expectations of aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes.
regime_hint: high inflation and tight labor market
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 235 and UNRATE < 5.0%, the 20-day forward returns of SPX are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (index 2017=100) over the prior month indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 105.0, the 20-day forward returns of SPX are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the prior quarter signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior quarter, the 60-day forward returns of SPX are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, the 60-day forward returns of SPX are positive in more than 60% of such instances.
